milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a coal block with a pickaxe causes the coal_block item to drop and enter the player's inventory. The player starts without any coal_block in inventory (confirmed via sandbox /clear check), so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. CommonSenseAgent confirmed that coal blocks drop themselves (not 9 coal) when mined with any pickaxe, and the wooden pickaxe provided is sufficient.
